name: COMP_056
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (85%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Flagged low-reliability composite frozen section cannot exclude Invasive; priority Tier 1 worklist case.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | InSitu 85%, Invasive 7%, Benign 7%, Normal 1% [F1] | Favors InSitu; low invasive score |
| Conformal set | InSitu, Invasive (90% target; 90% test coverage, ECE 5%) | Cannot separate InSitu from Invasive |
| Reliability / OOD | 32% reliability (flagged), 90th percentile OOD, 70% error AUROC [F6] | Suspect input; atypical versus training |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Disagree on top class | Foundation models split on diagnosis |
| Similar cases | 2/5 InSitu (40%); closest BACH_0278 is Invasive (82%) [F5] | Weak neighbor consensus; Invasive closest |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 2, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Strongest anti-invasive score (-1.41), but 0/20 AI spot-checked [F2] · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 2, 3, 7) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical benign stroma score (-0.84); 20/20 AI spot-checked [F3] · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 1, 4, 5) · ↑ invasive · Pushes toward invasion (+0.68), but weak and 0/20 spot-checked [F4] · Unreliable
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 1) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical duct confinement slightly favors invasion (+0.29); 12/20 spot-checked · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top-risk regions drops invasive score above random (95% CI 0.0021 to 0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven classifier faithfulness (deletion 95% CI -0.0088 to 0.0064 includes 0); relies on Unreliable `normal_lobules` and `mitoses` (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Left-half regions 0, 1, 4, 5, 8, 9 (98%–100% risk) harbor true invasion matching neighbor BACH_0278.
- Composite frozen-section quality (32% reliability) distorts tissue features, requiring the drafted H&E recut and deeper levels.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 1, 4, 5, 8, 9**: Inspect high-risk left half (98%–100% risk) for stromal invasion and mitoses.
2. **Regions 2, 3, 6, 7, 10, 11**: Verify whether low-risk right half (0%–3% risk) represents true benign lobules.
3. **Regions 0, 1, 4, 8, 9**: Defer margin call to permanent sections [F7]; review drafted recut and deeper levels.
